name: darus-mcp
description: Search, inspect and review DaRUS (University of Stuttgart Dataverse) datasets; optionally create and edit drafts.

api_token.title: DaRUS API token
api_token.description: Optional. Without it Claude sees only published datasets. In DaRUS, open the menu under your name and choose API Token.

allow_write.title: Allow creating and editing drafts
allow_write.description: Lets Claude create draft datasets and edit their metadata. Claude never publishes; you publish drafts yourself in DaRUS. Leave this off for read-only access.
